name: Dignity's Barb — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Dignity's Barb from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Dignity’s Barb" but are not part of the Dignity's Barb entry, which is unchanged.

DESCRIPTION

Brass inlay and military symbols adorn this masterwork darkwood light crossbow. An inscription bears the name of a famous general.

EFFECTS

Dignity’s Barb is a relic: a special magic item empowered by the zeitgeist and legend behind it. These once-grand items were powerful at the height of their legend, but time and ignorance have sapped the collective knowledge that charged them.

Dignity’s Barb counts as a masterwork crossbow that reduces the miss chance from concealment by 5%, but once the PCs complete this adventure, their growing legends can grant it the powers listed under its First Triumph entry.
